subject: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah@altustalent.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure

Team —

Following up from yesterday's debrief: we've completed final interviews for the Director, Infrastructure role (Daniel Cho). The candidate has signaled strong interest but needs an official offer to move forward. Attached are: the current offer draft, the Q4 comp band matrix, and the headcount change request showing a reallocation from a vacated L4 IC role.

Key ask: please authorize the offer and headcount move so Talent can extend no later than EOD Thursday. Specifics:
- Proposed base: $225,000
- Target OTE (bonus target): 15%
- Equity: 0.35% 4-year with 1y cliff
- Start window: mid-Jan 2027 (flexible)

Notes: this sits one band above the typical director band for SF hires; we recommend using the flex hiring buffer approved in Q3 to avoid an exception request. Finance (Laura) — need a quick sanity check on headcount delta and the run-rate impact to FY27. Vivek/Markus — please confirm leadership approval for band elevation and sign-off on offer comps.

Attachments: offer_letter_draft_DCho_v3.pdf; comp_band_matrix_Q4_2026.xlsx; headcount_change_request.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
VP, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure

Kimberly —

Thanks for the packet and the concise ask. I’m comfortable with the proposed comp given the candidate's background and the strategic impact of the role (platform reliability + multiregion rollout). I approve the band elevation on the condition that we:

1) Keep the bonus target at 15% (no acceleration).
2) Cap signing bonus to a one-time $20k if needed for relocation.
3) Include a 6-month check-in with TPM/Eng leads to reassess performance alignment.

Marissa — can you confirm we can absorb the equity grant within the pool approved last quarter? Laura — please confirm on run-rate; if there is a minor FY27 delta we should route through finance ops but not delay the offer.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure

Kimberly —

Reviewed the headcount change request. Short answer: we can approve operationally within the hiring flex buffer for Q4; the FY27 run-rate increase is ~ $58k (salary + benefits) excluding equity. Two items:

- Please submit a quick update in the HR headcount tracker (I updated row 42) with the expected FY27 start to align forecasting.
- If the candidate requests a signing bonus > $20k or earlier start that impacts recruiting costs, loop me immediately — we can escalate but prefer to keep within current cap.

I’m good to proceed from finance ops.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lim <sarah@altustalent.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure

Team —

Confirmed: equity allocation available in the Q4 refresh pool — 0.35% is okay. Recruiting is prepared to offer the compensation package as drafted. Sarah (Altus) — please hold until we get final sign-off from Kimberly; if Daniel requests competing offers, please flag immediately and send any updated comps.

Next step for Talent: once Kimberly confirms final verbiage for the role responsibilities (I suggest adding a single-line expectation around \"ownership of multiregion rollout cadence\"), we'll extend the formal offer.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@candidateemail.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah@altustalent.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Bcc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Headcount & Offer Authorization: Director, Infrastructure

Daniel —

Great speaking with you this morning. We're pleased to confirm leadership approval to extend an offer for Director, Infrastructure. I've attached the draft for transparency; final will be in DocuSign once you confirm accept. Highlights: base $225k, target bonus 15%, equity 0.35% (4y), relocation support up to $20k. We are targeting a mid-Jan start but can be flexible.

Please review and let me know three things by EOD Thursday: 1) whether the compensation band is acceptable, 2) any timing constraints for start/relocation, and 3) whether you want us to e-sign via DocuSign when ready. Sarah (Altus) — please support getting any counter-offer intelligence if we hear back from competing companies.

Attachments: offer_letter_draft_DCho_v3.pdf

Best,
Kimberly Park
VP, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
